headline: Coca-Cola Femsa Misses Quarterly Profit Forecast Despite Revenue Growth
summary: Coca-Cola Femsa reported third-quarter earnings that missed analysts' expectations by 1.09 Mexican pesos per ADR, even as overall net revenue surpassed consensus estimates.
why: Coca-Cola Femsa is the largest franchise bottler of Coca-Cola products by volume globally, serving consumer markets across Mexico, Central, and South America.

impacts.name: Coca-Cola FEMSA, S.A.B. de C.V.
impacts.why: An earnings-per-share miss signals persistent cost inflation pressures despite top-line sales strength.
